name: Healing
source:
"Healing" is a semi-romantic SFW visual novel that allows you to spend the day with a cute witch named Gwyn!

Gwyn is a gentle witch that appears to live in a magical fantasy realm. From what you've learned, she's studying the habits and culture of humans, but surely knows all sorts of magic...She likes cats, giant hats, and the color pink.

[From [url=https://maichu.itch.io/healing]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Healing》是一部半浪漫的SFW视觉小说，让你和一个名叫格温 (Gwyn) 的可爱女巫一起度过一天！

格温是一位温柔的女巫，似乎生活在一个神奇的幻想王国里。据你所知，她正在研究人类的习惯和文化，但肯定知道各种魔法……她喜欢猫、巨型帽子和粉红色。

[来自[url=https://maichu.itch.io/healing]Itch.io[/url]]
